articles.title: Turnout so far at record levels as Israelis vote in pivotal election
articles.description: The elections - the first since the Hamas-led attacks on Israel and the wars which followed - are widely seen as a referendum on Benjamin Netanyahu.

articles.title: Jordan carries out deadly strike in Syria in retaliation for church attack
articles.description: The attack on a village in Syria killed five people, including women and children, Syrian health officials said.

articles.title: What does Israel's election mean for Gaza and the wider world?
articles.description: The BBC's diplomatic correspondent James Landale reports from Jerusalem as ballots are cast.

articles.title: UK sanctions senior Sudanese commanders 'implicated in rape campaign'
articles.description: Senior Sudanese commanders allegedly implicated in a campaign of rape during the country's conflict have been sanctioned by the UK government.
